title: The Download: perimenopause misinformation and China’s latest AI leap

paragraphs.text: This is today's edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what's going on in the world of technology.
paragraphs.translation: 這是今日版本的 The Download，這是我們的平日電子報，每日為您提供科技界的最新動態。

paragraphs.text: There’s a lot of hype around perimenopause. Don’t buy it.
paragraphs.translation: 關於圍絕經期有許多炒作。別信。

paragraphs.text: Perimenopause used to be considered taboo, but not anymore. Thanks at least in part to TV doctors and social media influencers, conversations about the sometimes years-long period before menopause are now more open than ever. But the conversation is increasingly shaped by misinformation.
paragraphs.translation: 圍絕經期（更年期前期）過去被視為禁忌，但現在不再如此。至少部分歸功於電視醫生和社交媒體影響者，關於更年期前有時長達數年這段時期的對話比以往任何時候都更加開放。但這段對話越來越多地受到錯誤資訊的影響。

paragraphs.text: Despite what some marketers will claim, there is no test for perimenopause. That doesn’t mean women should have to put up with symptoms, but treatment suggestions often lack scientific evidence. And not all the symptoms women experience in midlife can be blamed on hormones.
paragraphs.translation: 儘管某些行銷人員宣稱，但目前並沒有針對圍絕經期的測試。這並不意味著女性必須忍受這些症狀，但治療建議通常缺乏科學證據。而且並非女性在中年經歷的所有症狀都可以歸咎於荷爾蒙。

paragraphs.text: Read the full story on the hype and misinformation surrounding perimenopause.
paragraphs.translation: 閱讀關於圍絕經期炒作與錯誤資訊的完整報導。

paragraphs.translation: —Jessica Hamzelou

paragraphs.text: The must-reads
paragraphs.translation: 必讀內容

paragraphs.text: I’ve combed the internet to find you today’s most fun/important/scary/fascinating stories about technology.
paragraphs.translation: 我搜遍了網路，為您找出了今日最有趣、重要、恐怖或迷人的科技故事。

paragraphs.text: 1 China's AI gap with the US may have just narrowed A Chinese startup has released the world's largest open AI model. (Reuters $) + It competes with some Anthropic and OpenAI models. (Gizmodo) + The model’s launch sent AI and semiconductor stocks sliding. (Bloomberg $) + Chinese Nvidia alternatives are also gaining traction. (SCMP) + Xi Jinping pitched China as an AI partner to the developing world. (CNBC) + The country is betting big on open-source. (MIT Technology Review) 2 Trump Media is selling instant access to “market-moving' social posts It’s developed a new way to monetize the president’s posts. (Quartz) + And Trump could profit directly from selling access to his statements. (BBC) + Kalshi says it caught Trump’s teleprompter operator insider trading﻿. (Verge) 3 Astronomers have found an atmosphere on a nearby Earth-like planet It’s the first potentially habitable world known to host an atmosphere. (NYT $) + Making it a top contender in the search for aliens. (404 Media) + But you need to know how to spot one. (MIT Technology Review) 4 A brain implant has restored feeling in a paralysed hand The recipient can now feed himself and drink from a cup. (Guardian) + Movement continued when the stimulation was turned off. (New Scientist $) + China has approved a world-first brain chip. (MIT Technology Review) 5 The EU has told Google to share search data and open up AI on Android It will be forced to share data with competing search providers. (Ars Technica) + And open Android phones to rivals’ AI bots. (WP $) 6 Period trackers are hiding privacy problems New research uncovers how they’re sharing users’ health data. (BBC) 7 The Tesla driver in a fatal Texas crash overrode FSD, investigators say He bypassed the tech by pressing the gas pedal to 100%. (Verge) 8 A new stealth drone spins so fast that it disappears Though its creators admit it can still be easily heard. (New Scientist $) 9 A space-station study suggests why astronauts’ bodies waste away Microgravity disrupts mitochondria, reducing protein production. (Nature) 10 “Adversarial clothing” that confuses facial recognition is all the rage Privacy could be the next big trend. (Guardian)
paragraphs.translation:
1. 中國與美國的 AI 差距可能剛剛縮小：一家中國新創公司發布了全球最大的開源 AI 模型。（路透社 $）+ 該模型可與 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的部分模型競爭。（Gizmodo）+ 該模型的發布導致 AI 和半導體股票下跌。（彭博社 $）+ 中國的輝達替代方案也正獲得關注。（南華早報）+ 習近平將中國定位為開發中國家的 AI 合作夥伴。（CNBC）+ 該國正大舉押注開源技術。（麻省理工科技評論）
2. 川普媒體公司正在販售「足以影響市場」的社交貼文即時存取權：它開發了一種將總統貼文變現的新方法。（Quartz）+ 川普可能直接從販售其聲明的存取權中獲利。（BBC）+ Kalshi 表示它抓到了川普的讀稿機操作員進行內線交易。（Verge）
3. 天文學家在一顆鄰近的類地行星上發現了大氣層：這是首個已知擁有大氣層的潛在宜居世界。（紐約時報 $）+ 這使其成為尋找外星人的首選。（404 Media）+ 但你需要知道如何發現它。（麻省理工科技評論）
4. 大腦植入物恢復了癱瘓手部的知覺：受試者現在可以自己進食並用杯子喝水。（衛報）+ 當刺激關閉後，動作仍能持續。（新科學人 $）+ 中國批准了全球首款腦機晶片。（麻省理工科技評論）
5. 歐盟要求 Google 分享搜尋數據並在 Android 上開放 AI：它將被強制與競爭的搜尋供應商分享數據。（Ars Technica）+ 並向對手的 AI 機器人開放 Android 手機。（華盛頓郵報 $）
6. 經期追蹤軟體正隱藏隱私問題：新研究揭露了它們如何分享用戶的健康數據。（BBC）
7. 調查人員稱，德州致命事故中的特斯拉駕駛覆蓋了 FSD 系統：他透過將油門踩到 100% 來繞過技術限制。（Verge）
8. 新型隱形無人機旋轉極快以至於消失：儘管其創造者承認它仍然很容易被聽到。（新科學人 $）
9. 一項太空站研究揭示了太空人身體萎縮的原因：微重力會擾亂粒線體，減少蛋白質生成。（自然）
10. 混淆面部識別的「對抗性服飾」正大行其道：隱私可能成為下一個大趨勢。（衛報）

paragraphs.text: Quote of the day
paragraphs.translation: 今日語錄

paragraphs.text: “Xi's message is clear: China is not going to follow anyone on both AI technology and ​standards. Instead, China is going ⁠to lead the world in both aspects.”
paragraphs.translation: 「習近平傳遞的信息很明確：中國不會在 AI 技術和標準上追隨任何人。相反，中國將在兩方面引領世界。」

paragraphs.text: —George Chen, chair in digital practice at The Asia Group consultancy, gives Reuters his take on Xi Jinping’s speech at the World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) in Shanghai.
paragraphs.translation: —George Chen，The Asia Group 諮詢公司的數位實踐主席，對習近平在上海世界人工智能大會（WAIC）上的講話向路透社發表看法。

paragraphs.text: How poop could feed the planet
paragraphs.translation: 糞便如何能養活地球

paragraphs.text: A new industrial facility in suburban Seattle is giving off a whiff of futuristic technology. It can safely treat fecal waste from people and livestock while recycling nutrients that are crucial for agriculture but in increasingly short supply across the nation’s farmlands.
paragraphs.translation: 西雅圖郊區的一個新工業設施正散發著一股未來科技的氣息。它可以安全地處理人類和牲畜的排泄物，同時回收對農業至關重要、但在全國農田中供應日益短缺的營養物質。

paragraphs.text: It’s among a range of systems reframing feces, urine, and their ingredients as invaluable natural resources to reuse instead of waste products to burn or bury. Several companies are now showing how to safely scale up the transformation with energy-efficient technologies.
paragraphs.translation: 這是一系列將糞便、尿液及其成分重新定位為寶貴自然資源，而非燃燒或掩埋的廢棄物的系統之一。幾家公司目前正展示如何透過節能技術安全地擴大這種轉型規模。

paragraphs.text: Find out how human waste is being transfomed into agricultural solutions.
paragraphs.translation: 了解人類排泄物如何被轉化為農業解決方案。
